title: Chain representative for ordinary pro-etale module cohomology pullback
statement:
Let $h:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], constant coefficient sheaves $A_X,A_Y$ and the canonical structure isomorphism $h^{-1}A_Y\cong A_X$ [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Write $h^*\dashv h_*$ and $Lh^*\dashv Rh_*$ for the module adjunctions of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; $h^*$ is exact and $Lh^*$ is its termwise derived functor. For $T=X,Y$, let $\Gamma_T$ be global sections of module sheaves, valued in $A$-modules, and define $R\Gamma_T(Q_TK)=Q_A\Gamma_T I(K)$ using K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex, prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist], where $Q_T$ and $Q_A$ are localization of cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let $I$ be a K-injective complex of $A_Y$-modules, $J$ a K-injective complex of $A_X$-modules, and $j:h^*I\to J$ any chain map. Denote the canonical comparisons by $a_I:R\Gamma_Y(Q_YI)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_A\Gamma_YI$, $a_J:R\Gamma_X(Q_XJ)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_A\Gamma_XJ$ and $c_I:Lh^*(Q_YI)\xrightarrow{\sim}Q_X(h^*I)$. Let $e_{h,F}:\Gamma_YF\to\Gamma_X(h^*F)$ be the sheaf-adjunction unit followed by the terminal-object identification $\Gamma_Yh_*\cong\Gamma_X$, and put $w=\Gamma_X(j)\circ e_{h,I}$, degree by degree. Write $\eta_h$ for the derived adjunction unit and $\lambda_{h,N}:R\Gamma_Y(Rh_*N)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\Gamma_XN$ for the canonical derived terminal-object (Leray) identification. Then the following equality holds in $D(A)$:
$$
 a_J^{-1}\circ Q_A(w)\circ a_I
 =R\Gamma_X(Q_X(j)\circ c_I)\circ\lambda_{h,Lh^*(Q_YI)}\circ R\Gamma_Y(\eta_{h,Q_YI}).
$$
No quasi-isomorphism hypothesis on $j$ is required.

proof.text: Use the recorded exact module adjunction L = h^*, F = h_* and the additive sections functors G = Gamma_Y, H = Gamma_X from [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. F preserves K-injective complexes by [lem-weil-pbc-right-adjoint-preserves-kinjective]. For e = proEtaleUnitLerayTerminalIso, use the existing proved composition construction [lem-fin-kinjective-derived-composition], which is exactly the definition of the Leray isomorphism in the item. Its universal-unit factorization gives beta_comp followed by lambda = Qh(e) followed by beta_H. In Lean this follows by unfolding rightDerivedFunctorCompIso' and cancelling rightDerivedUnique with its inverse, then applying rightDerivedNatTrans_fac. This is the private helper unitLeray_fac. All K-injective resolution instances are already supplied by the recorded operations.

Pass the recorded adjunction to homotopy categories using [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy]. The absolute derived adjunction construction of [lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived] is precisely mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction. Its defining unit equation derivedη_fac_app says eta at Qh(K), followed by RF(c_K), equals Qh(eta_h,K), followed by beta_F at L(K). These are the specified ordinary and derived units, with no change of adjunction.

Naturality of lambda at c_K moves RH(c_K) across lambda. Substitute the unit equation from step 2 inside RG, use naturality of beta_G at the homotopy-adjunction unit, and substitute the factorization in step 1. Functoriality of Qh gives beta_G,K;RG(eta);lambda;RH(c_K) = Qh(G(eta_h,K);e_LK);beta_H,LK. The inverse component of mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso for the identity is identity, by its proved refl_hom_app equation and the inverse law. This is the private helper unitLeray_h and uses no K-injectivity of K.

Take K to be the homotopy quotient of I and append RH(Q(j)). Naturality of beta_H at the quotient of j changes the right side to Qh of the ordinary sections unit followed by H(j), then beta_H,J. The termwise adjunction quotient equation of [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy] identifies this Qh arrow with Q(w). Unfold the quotient lifting comparisons, whose components on representatives are identities, to identify c_K with the recorded mapDerivedCategoryFactors at I.

Unfold the existing rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso at I and J. Its quotient comparison components on representatives are identities, so it is the inverse of beta_G,I and beta_H,J respectively. Cancel the invertible beta_G,I in the equation of step 4 and use functoriality RH(c_I;Q(j)) = RH(c_I);RH(Q(j)). This proves the displayed equality. The private generic helper unitLeray_chain carries out this cancellation; specialize it to the unchanged recorded pro-etale functors and terminal isomorphism. No map j, section unit, or derived adjunction unit is inverted.

tool_uses.why: Generic exact-left-adjoint criterion proves h_*J is K-injective; the Weil unit has no resolution-preservation replacement.
Generic resolution existence on small ringed sites supplies the module resolutions required by all derived constructions.
Generic unbounded derivability and evaluation on K-injectives fixes the canonical comparison isomorphisms.
Generic termwise adjunction identifies the chain adjunct of j before deriving.
Its canonical fraction-representative equation fixes the precise derived adjunct of the chain map, including both comparison isomorphisms.
Generic unbounded derived-map computation evaluates RΓ_Y on the map between the two K-injectives I and h_*J.
Generic ringed-topos direct-image composition, specialized to the terminal ringed topos, fixes the Leray normalization and its naturality.
